en.description:
From the creators of "Mini Billiards," comes a classic Doudizhu (Landlord Poker) game exclusively designed for Apple Watch!
Experience smart AI opponents, 3 difficulty levels, and immersive haptic feedback.
No internet needed. No iPhone needed. Just lift your wrist and play anytime, anywhere!

Game Features:

• Premium Offline Experience: One-time purchase, no ads, no data usage. Play on the subway, on a plane, or anywhere without signal.
• 3 Difficulty Levels:
   Easy Mode: Newbie friendly with great starting hands. Pure stress relief.
   Medium Mode: Classic strategy. Win with your skills.
   Hard Mode: High Rollers! High stakes, high rewards. Heart-pounding action!
• Emergency Aid System: Ran out of beans? Don't worry! The system provides free "Emergency Aid" beans to help you make a comeback. The fun never stops!
• Customizable Skins: Use your winnings to unlock premium table themes.
• Immersive Haptics: Large button layout optimized for the watch face, combined with Taptic Engine feedback for a satisfying gaming feel.
• Watch Face Complication: Add to your watch face for one-tap instant access. No waiting.

‌How to Play:‌

• Tap Cards: Tap to select cards (cards will float up); tap again to deselect.
• Play Cards: Tap the play button. The smart system auto-detects card patterns and prevents invalid moves.
• Bid for Landlord: Choose to bid 1-3 points based on your hand strength.
• Long Press to Quit: Perfect for a quick break! Long press the screen for 1 second to instantly exit the game and return to the watch face.
• Winning: The Landlord wins by playing all cards first. Farmers win if either teammate plays all cards first.
en.subtitle: Classic Doudizhu, Offline Play

zh.trackName: 掌上斗地主 - 手表游戏
zh.description:
继《掌上台球》之后，又一款专为 Apple Watch 打造的精致卡牌游戏！
智能 AI 博弈、三档难度挑战、极致震动反馈。
无需网络，无需手机，抬起手腕，随时随地来一局！

游戏特色：

• 极致单机体验：买断制无广告，无需网络，零流量消耗，地铁、飞机、信号死角都能玩。
• 三档难度挑战：
   简单模式：新手福利，把把好牌，解压神器。
   中级模式：经典博弈，以智取胜。
   困难模式：富豪场心跳对决，赢了翻倍，输了……
• 江湖救急系统：输光了？别怕！系统霸气赠送“救急金”，助你东山再起，绝不让你扫兴而归！
• 多款精美皮肤：努力赢取欢乐豆，解锁多种牌桌主题！
• 沉浸触感反馈：专为手表优化的大按键布局，配合震动反馈，出牌手感一流。
• 表盘小组件：支持添加到表盘，一键开局，拒绝等待。
• 全球排行榜: 支持全球排行榜，挑战每日、每周冠军。

‌游戏操作说明：‌

• 轻触卡牌：选中手牌（卡牌上浮），再次点击取消。
• 点击出牌：智能检测牌型，不符合规则自动拦截。
• 抢地主：根据手牌质量，策略选择 1-3 分。
• 长按屏幕：摸鱼必备功能，长按 1 秒即可快速退出游戏，深藏功与名。
• 胜利规则：作为地主先出完牌，或作为农民配合队友先出完牌‌即可胜利。
